section.name: List Hosts with VLAN (for selected VLANs / Vendor Code)
section.description: List hosts and the switch port connecting them to the network (including port-based VLAN).
section.usage: The optional VLANs setting can be a comma separated list of ranges, e.g. "101,105,200-299". The Vendor Code should take the form "080009" or "08:00:09" or "08-00-09". If an activity interval is supplied then a traffic query will be used to add addresses that may not map cleanly into one VLAN or may not be located on an interface you are monitoring. Remove the activity interval to turn off this query. The Max VLANs setting helps to eliminate router MACs that may carry many VLANs.
